CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(Last_Completed_Call_Date_Time__c) || DATEVALUE(Last_Completed_Call_Date_Time__c) < Sales_Cycle_Start_Date__c, NULL, IF( TODAY() > Sales_Cycle_End_Date__c, Sales_Cycle_End_Date__c - DATEVALUE(Last_Completed_Call_Date_Time__c), TODAY() - DATEVALUE(Last_Completed_Call_Date_Time__c) ) )
CustomField.label: Days Since Last Completed Visit
